### He Who Was Born of God
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/he-who-was-born-god
Passage: 1 John 5:18-19
Points:
- Believers cannot preserve their faith by personal strength alone, but rely on the continual intercession of Jesus.
- Those born of God are guarded by Christ so that sin no longer exercises dominating control over their lives.
- Christians still stumble into sin, but true believers will not persist in hardened, unrepentant rebellion.
- Unlike the world under the evil one's grip, believers are kept secure from final spiritual destruction.
- An earnest desire to repent and seek forgiveness demonstrates that sin has lost its ultimate power over the believer.
